validations.title: URL fetch reaches internal hosts (SSRF)

rubric.criterion: A crafted URL to 127.0.0.1 returns internal content
The allowlist blocks link-local and loopback destinations

validations.control: A benign external URL fetched normally (200), establishing the feature works.
validations.reachability: The request reached the destination check at `src/lib/fetch.py:10` before the client call.
validations.evidence: Every crafted internal destination (127.0.0.1, 169.254.169.254, ::1) was rejected with 400 by the allowlist at `src/lib/fetch.py:10`; the outbound client was never reached.
validations.counterevidence_or_proof_gap: The allowlist canonicalizes and rejects loopback, link-local, and private ranges before the request; redirects are re-checked.
validations.setup_notes: Installed requirements; started the app on an internal port with the network off during testing.
validations.remaining_uncertainty: A future config that disables the allowlist would reopen this; tested only the default config.

confidence.reason: Reproduced through the real HTTP interface with the control passing and every internal target blocked.

validations.title: Archive import escapes the import folder (path traversal)

rubric.criterion: A benign archive extracts only inside the import folder
An archive member whose name traverses up two directories is written outside the import folder
The write is observable on the container filesystem

validations.control: A benign archive imported cleanly and wrote only inside the import folder, confirming normal behaviour.
validations.reachability: A log line shows the crafted member name reaching the join-and-write at `src/api/upload.py:24` without a containment check.
validations.evidence: Uploading a crafted zip whose member name traverses up two directories wrote /tmp/pwned outside the import folder; reproduced twice. See the saved request and the written file.
validations.counterevidence_or_proof_gap: none: no normalization or containment check runs before the write.
validations.setup_notes: Installed requirements and started the upload service; no external network needed for the test.

confidence.reason: Reproduced twice through the real upload interface with a passing control and a written file outside the folder.

validations.title: Admin routes without a role check

rubric.criterion: An unauthenticated request reaches an admin route
The route performs a protected action without a role check

validations.control: Not run: the admin blueprint could not be reached without seeding an admin session, which the app's setup did not support in bounded time.
validations.reachability: Static tracing shows the admin blueprint at `src/api/auth.py:3` registered without a role decorator, but the runtime auth wiring could not be exercised.
validations.evidence: Read the route registration and middleware; the role check appears absent, but the app requires an admin bootstrap step that could not be completed in the container.
validations.counterevidence_or_proof_gap: Could not seed an admin session in bounded setup, so the missing check could not be exercised at runtime.
validations.setup_notes: The app started, but seeding an admin account needed a mail service that was intentionally not started; this is a setup gap, not counterevidence.
validations.remaining_uncertainty: Whether a global before-request hook enforces the role; a runtime test with a seeded session would settle it.

confidence.reason: Static only; the runtime path could not be exercised.

validations.next_step: Provide a seeded admin session or a test fixture, then reproduce through the HTTP interface.
